referenceData.name: Vehicle Option Codes
referenceData.description: A large static reference table (columns: Code, Title, Description) listing Tesla vehicle build option codes — the values returned in a vehicle's 'option_codes' field — covering trim options, region, battery size/type, color/paint, wheels, roof, interior, adapters/charging connectors, autopilot hardware, and many add-on packages. The table runs to several hundred rows.
